analysis: GELU, layernorm and depth of at least 3 are what matter. Depth-3 and depth-4 voxel recipes with gamma 0.99 and lambda 0.95 all score 0.990-1.0 on dev. That is about 5 dev designs out of 512, which is seed and eval noise. Dev success of 1.0 appeared in t13, t16 and t27, but repeats of t13 and t16 gave 0.998. Differences among the top recipes are therefore not meaningful. The 4-epoch, depth-3, step-penalty-0.01 family is consistently 0.996-1.0 at about 335s, well under the limit. The last round tests small variants of the t27 recipe, plus one exact repeat of it to measure noise.

proposals.hypothesis: Exact repeat of t27 (128 envs, rollout 32, 4 epochs, penalty 0.01, dev 1.0) to measure seed noise. Refuted if dev success is below 0.996.
t27 with 2 epochs is cheaper (about 190s) and tests whether longer rollouts alone give the gain. Refuted if dev success is below 0.996.
t27 with 64 envs and rollout 32 gives more rollouts and updates per step budget. Refuted if dev success is below 0.998.
t27 with entropy 0.01 and lambda 1.0 should give a sharper policy and lower-bias returns at long rollout. Refuted if dev success is below 0.998.
